technical.summary: CVS shows strong trend structure with price above all key MAs and bullish directional indicators, but overbought RSI(14) and negative MACD histogram suggest caution on new entries; better suited for existing longs or pullback entries.

fundamental.summary: CVS shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces elevated earnings risk in 29 days with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity (2 sales, 1 purchase by junior members) with no composite signal; market fear (43/100) presents potential contrarian opportunity but lack of news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (285.12) with imminent CPI event (1 day) creates acute volatility risk; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 29 days adds secondary event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with bullish supertrend and strong ADX trend structure provides solid technical foundation for continuation.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis (285.12), imminent CPI event (1 day), overbought RSI (70.56), negative MACD divergence, zero fundamental support, and no insider conviction create compounding risk that outweighs technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure remains intact with price above all major MAs and bullish supertrend, but this does not justify new exposure given macro headwinds and fundamental vacuum.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis (285.12) combined with imminent CPI event (1 day) creates acute volatility spike risk that can invalidate technical setup; overbought RSI and negative MACD divergence suggest exhaustion into event.
decision.recommended_exit: N/A — skip entry; if managing existing position, use ATR trail 1x to protect against VIX-driven reversal.
